# BrushForge

> BrushForge is an independent miniature-paint converter and painting toolkit for Android and iOS.
> It helps painters compare recorded paint colors across brands, track paints they own, save recipes,
> build palettes, and plan projects. Core app tools are offline-friendly. Verified August 4, 2026.

## Key facts

- Platforms: Android and iOS. The apps are free to start, contain optional in-app purchases, and may
  contain advertising.
- App catalogue: 4,300+ paints and growing. Expanding coverage is the current main focus, including
  direct collaboration with paint brands. The crawlable public website catalogue contains 2,941
  selected records across opaque, metallic, wash, ink, glaze, single-coat, and other translucent
  behaviour families; the counts describe different surfaces.
- Matching: stored sRGB/hex color values are converted to CIELAB and compared with CIEDE2000. Lower
  ΔE2000 means a closer recorded color value.
- Limitations: a catalogue match is a shortlist, not proof that two physical paints are equivalent.
  Finish, opacity, coverage, hue bias, undercoat, lighting, paint type, and application all matter.
  Screen swatches also vary by display, calibration, True Tone/Night Shift, and ambient lighting.
- Compatibility: standard opaque colors, metallics, washes, and transparent single-coat products
  should not be treated as behaviorally interchangeable solely because their recorded color is close.
- Feature availability: paint conversion, inventory, recipes, projects, palettes, and photo color tools
  are available on Android and iOS. Community is currently available on Android only.
- Offline: the paint library, collection, recipes, palettes, and core tools are offline-friendly.
  Account services, purchases, Community, and connected photo suggestions require internet access.
- Sync: data syncs automatically between devices on the same platform, with manual backup and restore
  also available. Android and iOS do not have complete cross-platform sync, and manual transfers may
  be incomplete.
- Web roadmap: public web accounts and app sync are a long-term goal without an announced release date.
- Android plans: Free includes up to 40 paints, 5 recipes, and 1 project and contains ads. Premium
  removes ads and increases paint collection and project allowances. Exact paid allowances and local
  pricing are shown in the Android app and Google Play.
- Import: current iOS releases support inventory CSV and selected paint-tracker imports plus supported
  BrushForge backup restoration. Import paths can differ by platform and release.
- Identity: BrushForge is built by Bastiaan Mahieu in Belgium. It is not affiliated with or endorsed
  by Games Workshop or any paint manufacturer.

## Primary resources

- [Web converter](https://brushforgeapp.com/convert/): interactive catalogue matching with static,
  indexable chart equivalents.
- [Public paint catalogue](https://brushforgeapp.com/paints/): individual paint pages, recorded-color
  alternatives, paint metadata, and report links.
- [Matching methodology](https://brushforgeapp.com/methodology/): calculation pipeline, practical ΔE
  tiers, sources, limitations, update policy, and correction process.
- [Guide hub](https://brushforgeapp.com/guides/): authored guides about ΔE2000, recipe translation,
  paint behavior, discontinued colors, and collection tracking.
- [Paint converter feature](https://brushforgeapp.com/features/paint-converter/#paint-details)
- [Paint inventory and palette](https://brushforgeapp.com/features/paint-inventory/#your-palette)
- [Recipes and projects workflow](https://brushforgeapp.com/features/recipes-projects/#workflow)
- [Community availability](https://brushforgeapp.com/features/recipes-projects/#community)
- [Photo, light, and shadow tools](https://brushforgeapp.com/features/photo-color-tools/#light-and-shadow)
- [Press and reviewer information](https://brushforgeapp.com/press/)
- [Founder story](https://brushforgeapp.com/the-story.html)
